newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds end quiet as Chicago surges again.
newsitem.headline: European feeds end quiet as Chicago surges again.

text.p: A scorching start to Chicago soy futures on Monday provided Europe's physical trade with more evidence of a hair-trigger weather market and the benefits of restricting purchases to a minimum.

There were no trades in South American soymeal after sellers raised European asking prices in line with the Chicago opening. CBOT soybeans surged by up to around 20 cents on renewed reports of hot, dry weather in the U.S. Midwest. "Buying interest dropped to zero on the opening," one European trader commented.
Fluctuating futures values have killed off Europe's physical trade in the past few weeks.
